title: What kind of voice is it
html_source: Bloom is searching his memory for a specific word here. The word he is seeking is “castrato”. Per Wikipedia, a castrato is “a type of classical male singing voice equivalent to that of a soprano, mezzo-soprano, or contralto. The voice is produced by castration of the singer before puberty, or it occurs in one who, due to an endocrinological condition, never reaches sexual maturity.”
